Class AbstractAsiContainer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.event.BasicPropertyChangeSource
uno.anahata.asi.AbstractAsiContainer
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractSwingAsiContainer
public abstract class AbstractAsiContainer extends BasicPropertyChangeSource
A hybrid static/instance class for managing global and application-specific configurations.
  • Static methods provide access to the root Anahata AI working directory and its global subdirectories.
  • An instance of this class represents the configuration for a specific host application (e.g., "netbeans", "standalone"), managing its unique preferences and its own application-specific subdirectories.
Author:
anahata-gemini-pro-2.5

      public static String getAsiCoreImplementationVersion()
      Resolves the implementation version of the foundational Anahata ASI Core framework.

    • getMavenGroupId

      public String getMavenGroupId()
      Resolves the Maven Group ID of this container artifact.

      Defaults to "uno.anahata". Development Notice: This method is used in development mode to locate pom.properties on the classpath when running directly off target/classes.

      Returns:
      The Maven groupId string.

    • getMavenArtifactId

      public String getMavenArtifactId()
      Resolves the Maven Artifact ID of this specific host container module.

      Development Notice: Subclasses representing specific host environments (e.g. anahata-asi-desktop, anahata-asi-nb) should override this method so that getContainerImplementationVersion() can fish the build version from /META-INF/maven/<groupId>/<artifactId>/pom.properties when running directly off target/classes in development mode.

      Returns:
      The Maven artifactId string, or null if unknown.

    • getContainerImplementationVersion

      public String getContainerImplementationVersion()
      Resolves the implementation version of this specific host container artifact.

      Resolution Hierarchy:

      1. Queries getClass().getPackage().getImplementationVersion() (active in packaged production JARs and NBMs).
      2. In development mode (when running off target/classes), fishes the version from /META-INF/maven/<getMavenGroupId()>/<getMavenArtifactId()>/pom.properties on the classpath.
      3. Falls back to getAsiCoreImplementationVersion().
      Returns:
      The container implementation version string, or null if unresolved.

    • getContainerVersion

      public String getContainerVersion()
      Resolves the clean container version string used for the container directory.

      Discards any qualifiers or build timestamps after the first dash ('-'). For example, '1.2.0-20260904' or '1.2.0-SNAPSHOT' becomes '1.2.0'.

      Returns:
      The clean version string, or null if unresolved.

    • cloneAgi

      public Agi cloneAgi(@NonNull @NonNull Agi agi, String newSessionId)
      Authoritatively clones an existing Agi session or template.

      Implementation details: Performs a deep clone using Kryo, assigns the new session ID, and updates the nickname. By placing this logic in the core container, we ensure architectural purity across different UI frameworks.

      Parameters:
      agi - The source Agi session to clone.
      newSessionId - Optional custom ID for the cloned session or template. If null or blank, a random UUID is generated.
      Returns:
      The newly cloned and registered Agi session.
